How Income is Calculated
For salaried employees:
Based on average gross monthly income over 12 months from CPF records or the
latest IRAS assessment (within the last 2 years).
Includes: basic salary, bonuses, commissions, overtime pay, allowances, cash
rewards, and employee CPF contributions.
For self-employed individuals:
Based on average trade income over 12 months from the latest IRAS assessment
(within the last 2 years), or income declared to CPF Board.
Note: Family members refer to the child’s grandparents or siblings below 21 years old who
live at the same address, are not working or have no income, and are Singapore Citizens or
Permanent Residents.
Your gross monthly income will be determined via HOMES as part of the means-test.
For further information, please refer to MSF | Student Care Fee Assistance.
